categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen YHLO Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of chemiluminescence immunoassay instruments and reagents. The company also engages in the agency sales of medical devices from international brands. Its product portfolio includes diagnostic instruments and reagents for autoimmune diseases, reproductive health, infectious diseases, diabetes, liver diseases, cardiovascular diseases, and more.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include magnetic particle acridinium ester chemiluminescence immunoassay, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunoblotting, colloidal gold chromatography, indirect immunofluorescence, and biochemical diagnostics. It has developed a comprehensive chemiluminescence platform with proprietary intellectual property, including patented technologies in instruments, reagents, magnetic beads, and labeling. Production follows strict medical device and IVD reagent manufacturing standards with quality control throughout the process.
categories.primary_customers_markets: YHLO serves primarily domestic and international medical institutions, including tertiary hospitals, secondary hospitals, and independent third-party laboratories. Its products cover over 5,980 domestic medical institutions, including more than 1,240 top-tier hospitals, with a national coverage rate exceeding 69% for top-tier hospitals. Overseas markets include the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa, covering 117 countries and regions. Customers span clinical diagnostics, research institutions, and healthcare providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen and other locations such as Hunan, Shanghai, and Nanjing. It has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Japan, Macau, and other regions. Overseas sales cover more than 110 countries and regions worldwide, including the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa, with a growing presence in Southeast Asia and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: YHLO operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain. It develops and manufactures diagnostic instruments and reagents (midstream) and sells these products directly or through distributors to medical institutions (downstream). The company also procures some core raw materials like antigens and antibodies externally but is increasing its self-production capabilities for key biological raw materials to enhance supply chain stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in chemiluminescence immunoassay technology, expanding its diagnostic reagent menu, and developing new instruments including automated laboratory systems and microfluidic platforms. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on autoimmune diseases, reproductive health, molecular diagnostics, and gene sequencing. YHLO also emphasizes localization of raw material production, AI-enabled development of biological reagents, and strengthening its global academic and clinical research collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: YHLO generates revenue primarily through the sale of self-developed IVD instruments and reagents. It also earns income from agency sales of third-party medical devices. The sales model includes direct sales to key domestic customers and distributors for other regions, with overseas sales conducted mainly through distributors. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or completion of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: YHLO is positioned as a leading domestic IVD company in China, especially in chemiluminescence immunoassay technology, competing against multinational giants like Roche, Abbott, Beckman Coulter, and Siemens. It has broken foreign monopolies in certain diagnostic fields and is recognized as a top domestic brand with strong market penetration in autoimmune and reproductive health diagnostics. The company faces competition from both international and emerging domestic IVD firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, YHLO reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.01 billion, a slight decline of 2.02% year-over-year mainly due to reduced COVID-19 related sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 301.5 million, down 15.06%. However, net profit excluding non-recurring items grew by 30.84%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 4.42 billion, with equity of RMB 2.76 billion. R&D investment accounted for 16.8% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile with steady expansion in non-COVID business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: YHLO emphasizes its proprietary chemiluminescence immunoassay technology platform with patented innovations, offering high sensitivity, specificity, and automation capabilities. Its comprehensive product menu covers a wide range of diagnostic fields with strong clinical validation and regulatory approvals domestically and internationally. The company provides integrated laboratory automation solutions and intelligent software systems, delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and localized products that meet diverse clinical needs and support healthcare modernization.
